options.misconception: More bulbs in the circuit means more light
Parallel is brighter than a single bulb
Branches share the battery's energy, so each parallel bulb is dimmer

questions.explanation: Each bulb in Y is across the battery, so it gets the same voltage and current as Z. In X the bulbs share the voltage, so each is dimmer.

options.misconception: Current is used up (it is energy that is transferred; current is the same all the way round a series loop)

questions.explanation: Two bulbs in series have double the resistance, so the current halves. It is the same everywhere in the loop.

options.misconception: All metals are magnetic (brass is copper and zinc)
Metals that conduct well are magnetic

questions.explanation: Only iron, steel, nickel and cobalt are magnetic. Brass, aluminium and copper are metals but are not attracted.

options.misconception: Reversing the current makes it stronger (it only swaps the poles)
Any rod will do as a core
More wire anywhere means a stronger magnet

questions.explanation: More turns in the coil gives a stronger field (so do more current or an iron core). Reversing only swaps the poles.
